notes: New state, not in Cliopatria. Disagreements: Alexander of Epirus dies in 331 (his page) or 326 (Bruttii page), and his conquests are 'Heraclea, Terina, Sipontum' (his page) or 'Heraclea, Consentia, Terina' (Bruttii page). Not placed because the pages give no year: Agathocles of Syracuse's raid and capture of Hipponium and the peace the Bruttians broke; the peace after Pyrrhus (272 is a bridge). The Bruttii were Rome's allies (socii) between the peace of c. 272 and their defection after Cannae; roman-republic's ledger has no vassal_start/vassal_end for them and gives the 203 gain to 'carthage' as counterpart ('Samnium, Lucania and Bruttium'): it should name bruttii (and lucanians, samnites) and add the 272 vassal tie. Rome's -216 'loss carthage ... Bruttium' likewise. The end year 203 is the midpoint of the page's '204-2'; the 203 date for Hannibal's departure is in the roman-republic dossier, not on any page opened here. The southern tip (Reggio, Locri, Rhegium) stays outside: Rhegium 'remained firm' and Locri was Greek. Wikidata id left null. Family 'italy' is a registry key.
